entry.name: %FACTORY_JENKINS_URL%
entry.comment: URL of the Jenkins building the applications of the projects, its Jenkins URL; empty switches CI off.

entry.name: %FACTORY_JENKINS_USER%
entry.comment: Jenkins user the control application makes its requests as, with the API token in the secret tl_factory_jenkins_token.

entry.name: %FACTORY_JENKINS_FOLDER%
entry.comment: Jenkins folder of the jobs of the projects, nested folders separated by slashes; empty for the top level.

entry.name: %FACTORY_JENKINS_SCM_CREDENTIALS%
entry.comment: ID of the Jenkins credential the jobs check out the project repositories with; empty for none.
